Buy a Swiss ID Card on Telegram

The advertised price for a Swiss id card on Telegram usually sits between 110–360 CHF. Anything far below that band is a print and anything far above it should come with a register check you can run yourself.

Document type
An ID card is a domestic identity document issued by a civil registry, police force or municipal office. It proves identity inside the country and usually nothing outside it.

buy swiss id card on telegram – the short version

For a Swiss id card the realistic expectation is 110–360 CHF and one to three weeks of waiting. Same day delivery at the bottom of the band usually means a digital file rather than a card.

Read the price table before you open a chat, not after. Knowing the band stops you anchoring on whatever number the seller opens with.

Buy a ID Card via Telegram: how the transaction works

The transaction runs in a private chat, usually after a public channel advert. That is fine. What matters is that the sequence is fixed before money moves: photos first, then a number check, then payment, then tracked delivery.

Some sellers will push for the full amount up front. Offer the deposit and hold firm on the balance. Most accept and the ones who do not are usually reselling stock they do not have.

Who actually issues a ID Card

It helps to know that the commune does not sell to the public through Telegram. The chain always ends at that office and the register it keeps is the only authority that counts.

If the seller names a different office, that is not automatically wrong. the commune may delegate. But the answer should be specific enough to be checkable, and vague regional answers are not.

Replica or registered original

The middle tier is stock. The seller has real blank or cancelled stock of the right type and prints onto it, so the physical layer is genuine and the number is invented. Most adverts at the middle of the band are this.

Some sellers will not send a number before a deposit. That is a reasonable position, but the deposit should be small and the number should follow immediately after it.

What a fair price looks like

Treat 110–360 CHF as the market for a Swiss id card and every deviation as a claim to be tested. A high price is a promise of quality, so make the seller keep it.

The honest summary is that you get what the tier buys. Pay the print price for a print, the stock price for stock, and the top price only when somebody proves the number.

The buying process, step by step

Work through these in order. Each step exists because it is where a bad Swiss id card deal usually breaks.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is the commune.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format the commune uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 110–360 CHF band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

The five checks below take minutes and catch almost everything. Two of them are specific to Switzerland.

  • Check the licence for the cantonal header and confirm the categories follow the Swiss layout rather than the EU one.
  • Check the identity card for the Swiss cross printing and the UV features.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for the commune. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

Red flags specific to Switzerland, plus the generic tells that apply anywhere.

  • A C permit with no cantonal reference number.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

How much is an ID card on Telegram?

Between 90 and 500 US dollars. A print sits at the bottom, a chip card with a valid number at the top.

Is an ID card worth buying at all?

It is the cheapest document to fake convincingly, so it is also the one most often faked badly. Buy it only with a number check.

Do ID cards work abroad?

Inside the issuing country, yes. Outside it, most are only accepted as secondary evidence.

What is the giveaway on a fake ID?

The number. It is the one part that has to obey a rule, and sellers who invent numbers rarely know the rule.

Can I check an ID number myself?

In most countries yes, because the algorithm is published. Search for the country name and check digit.
